audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Ryze wins Level 1 while whys[0] described Urgot chunking you from range — the two layers contradicted each other, and both contradicted the packet chart.
audit.why: Corrosive Charge (Q) is an 800-range poke; Ryze's Q is 1000 but his damage pattern needs Flux (E, 615). Urgot's early lane is stronger; Ryze's edge arrives at first item.
audit.corrected: Chart set to the packet: Urgot, Urgot, Skill, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Skill — proposed as paired full/content rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text used 'W shotgun legs' and never named Echoing Flames or Purge; late-game spike asserted a 25% execute threshold.
audit.why: Riot's text gives no numeric threshold for Fear Beyond Death, only 'a health threshold'. Asserting 25% is unverified.
audit.corrected: Named Echoing Flames (P) and Purge (W); replaced the numeric threshold with 'below Fear Beyond Death's threshold'. Ryze spikes stated as Level 3 combo, Rod of Ages, Seraph's.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Disdain (E) shields Urgot as it charges, so it absorbs the burst window Ryze needs. Content also claimed 'His kit has no dash'.
audit.why: Urgot's E charges in a direction and shields him (kit flags: dash-class charge + shield). Ryze's W roots — and Flux-upgraded W is a root, which denies that charge. Naming the shield tells the player why an uncooled commit fails.
audit.corrected: Stated the shield absorbing burst, corrected the 'no dash' claim to 'Disdain is his only gap-closer and a root denies it', and keyed the window to Disdain's 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s cooldown.

audit.why: Disdain 16s at rank 1 and Purge 12s at rank 1 (0s at rank 5) are the two clocks the lane runs on.
audit.corrected: Both numbers written into the phase and prose edits.

audit.why: Ryze Q and E are projectiles (Wind Wall-class blockable) — not relevant against Urgot, so nothing written.

edits.before: Q poke only — farm, respect everything, and bank Manaflow stacks. You're buying time, not fighting.
edits.after: Corrosive Charge outranges your walk-up and Echoing Flames chips — last-hit with Q, bank Manaflow.

edits.before: W root threatens jungle follow-up, but it's also your kite tool — spending it greedily is how you die.
edits.after: Disdain flips you every 16s at rank 1 and shields him doing it — W is insurance against that, not poke.

edits.before: Rod of Ages ends the HP problem — your short trades become favourable on raw math.
edits.after: Rod of Ages ends the HP problem — you outlast Echoing Flames on raw math now.

edits.before: Seraph's online — you out-DPS and out-tank everyone in extended fights. Side-lane and Warp to every fight.
edits.after: Seraph's online, but Fear Beyond Death still executes you under its threshold — Warp to fights, never race him low.

edits.before: Urgot's Q fires from range and his W shotgun legs deal percent-max-HP even before you can walk into Flux range — stay back and last-hit with Q.
edits.after: Corrosive Charge fires from 800 and Echoing Flames blasts off every Purge tick, so he chips you outside Flux range — last-hit with Q and hold W.

edits.before: He has enough level-2 threat from E-flip setup that you do not yet have the combo to punish it cleanly — trade only if your W root lands first.
edits.after: Disdain shields him as it flips you, so a level-2 trade costs your health and your W — contest only while Disdain sits on its 16-second cooldown.

edits.before: Both of you are pre-item and his percent-HP legs keep the sustained damage close — farm safely and contest only when his W is down.
edits.after: Pre-item, Echoing Flames keeps his sustained damage close — farm safely and step up only while Purge is on its 12-second rank-1 cooldown.

edits.before: Urgot's Q poke and W shotgun legs shred you before you can walk up to Flux range — respect his level 1 harass and do not give him a free W proc.
edits.after: Corrosive Charge pokes from 800 and Purge fires Echoing Flames off his legs before you reach Flux range — respect level 1 and never stand in Purge's 490.

edits.before: Your E-W-Q loop comes online; if Urgot steps into melee range to E-flip you, root him first with W and cycle Flux — the combo trades even here.
edits.after: Your E-W-Q loop comes online; Flux him first so W roots instead of slowing, and the root denies Disdain outright — that is the trade you win at level 3.

edits.before: Urgot's E-flip into R execute is a death sentence if you are below 25% HP — use Realm Warp to reposition your team and never let him land E on you when low.
edits.after: Disdain into Fear Beyond Death is a death sentence once you drop under its execute threshold — Warp out rather than trading, and never eat the charge while low.

edits.before: His flip engage — sidestep it and he has no way to start. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Disdain shields him as it lands, so it eats your burst — bait it out, then commit into its 16-second downtime.

edits.before: Urgot burns Disdain (Flip) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Urgot burns Disdain on a minion — take the whole 16-second invitation.

notes: Kit flags list Urgot's Q as a dash; Riot's own description says it fires an explosive charge at a location, so the dash flag is a parsing misfire — Disdain (E) is the actual charge. Nothing written from the Q flag. Fear Beyond Death's execute threshold is not numeric in Riot's text, so the inherited '25% HP' claim was removed rather than restated. Content-layer prose (early/mid/late) still says 'His kit has no dash' inside mid; left alone this pass because a full-length rewrite of that block was outside the band I could verify — flagged in unverified.
